findings.claim: HubSpot 10-K 風險因子列出關稅或其他貿易限制為國際營運風險之一，並指出其業務受美國 EAR 及 OFAC 出口管制與制裁法規約束；未見具體關稅金額影響。
findings.excerpt: Our business activities are subject to various restrictions under U.S. and other global export controls and trade and economic sanctions laws, including the U.S. Commerce Department’s Export Administration Regulations and economic and trade sanctions regulations maintained by the U.S. Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control.

findings.claim: MD&A 將關稅或其他貿易限制列為可能影響經營結果的總體經濟因素之一，未量化。
findings.excerpt: Our results of operations may be significantly influenced by general macroeconomic conditions, including, but not limited to, the impact of pandemics, geo-political conflicts, foreign currency fluctuations, interest rates, inflation, recession risks, tariffs or other trade restrictions

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋 1 次無 HubSpot 關稅專屬新聞；純軟體訂閱，僅一手文件泛稱風險。
